title: Sigurnosni koncepti i principi dizajna
summary: Kriptografija i ključevi (CMK, BYOK, HYOK), IAM, sanitizacija i crypto-shredding, mrežna i virtualizacijska sigurnost, cloud prijetnje i higijena, te principi dizajna: data lifecycle, BIA i BC/DR (RTO/RPO/RSL), lock-in, okviri i DevSecOps.
summary_en: Cryptography and key management (CMK, BYOK, HYOK), IAM, sanitization and crypto-shredding, network and virtualization security, cloud threats and hygiene, plus design principles: the data lifecycle, BIA and BC/DR (RTO/RPO/RSL), lock-in, frameworks and DevSecOps.
